title: Marinated Flank Steak
summary: Soy, lime and garlic marinade, hot and fast on the grill or under the broiler, sliced thin against the grain.

steps.title: Marinade
steps.text: Whisk the soy sauce, olive oil, lime juice, brown sugar, garlic, cumin and pepper in a zip bag or shallow dish.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Add the steak, press out the air, and refrigerate 1 to 8 hours. Longer than that and the lime starts to turn the surface mealy. Take it out 30 minutes before cooking.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Grill on high, or broiler on high with a rack 4 to 5 inches from the element and a foil-lined pan preheating.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Pat the steak mostly dry and cook 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, 125 to 130°F in the thickest part. Flank is thin; it goes from perfect to grey fast.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Move to a board and rest 10 minutes. Do not skip this or the board gets the juice instead of the plate.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Find the grain (the long lines running down the steak) and slice thinly across it, knife at a slight angle. Finish with flaky salt.

notes: Skirt steak works the same way with a minute less per side. Leftovers are good cold in a salad or tacos.
